evidence: The paper uses confirmatory factor analysis and structural equation modeling to examine core vs. peripheral criteria in social media addiction scales. Random forests (missRanger/ranger) appear only in the missing data imputation section: "the missRanger R package was used to impute missing values by using random forests with the ranger algorithm." The primary analyses use latent variable models (CFA/SEM), not random forest variable importance. No impurity-based importance measures are reported or interpreted.
